verdict.rationale: Gumloop's first-party docs describe event-driven automation. App triggers fire an agent when something happens in an external service, webhook triggers run an agent when any system POSTs to its unique URL, and scheduled triggers cover time-based runs. Outbound organization webhooks also notify your systems when events occur. missing for 10: documentation of conditional rule logic (filters or conditions that decide whether a trigger fires), detail on which app events are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
